events.verdict: Gasol (MEM) reaches in and affects Embiid's (PHI) ability to control the ball.
Martin (MEM) and Simmons (PHI) briefly engage and separate during rebounding.
Martin (MEM) sets the screen on Simmons (PHI) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Saric (PHI) obtains a legal guarding position and jumps vertically contesting Evans' (MEM) driving shot attempt.
Luwawu-Cabarrot (PHI) makes contact to Gasol (MEM) that affects his control of the ball.
RHH shows that Simmons (PHI) dislodges the ball from Martin (MEM) and the contact after the ball is loose is incidental.
Embiid (PHI) sets the screen on Gasol (MEM) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Chalmers (MEM) legally contests Covington's (PHI) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
RO SLA shows Gasol (MEM) makes contact to Embiid's (PHI) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Simmons (PHI) commits a take foul on Evans (MEM).
Gasol (MEM) legally contests Embiid's (PHI) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release is considered incidental.
Martin (MEM) dislodges Simmons (PHI) from his legally obtained guarding position.
Martin (MEM) makes contact to Embiid's (PHI) body that affects his driving shot attempt.
Simmons (PHI) cleanly deflects the ball away from Evans (MEM).
[Observable in enhanced video] Freeze frame with RHH angle appears to show that Evans (MEM) makes slight contact to Covington's (PHI) arm while he still has the ball in his hand.
Simmons (PHI) commits a take foul on Chalmers (MEM).
